name: VMS - Fulfillment, Assembly and Warehousing
old_description: Our mission here at VMS Inc., a 3PL and fulfillment provider, is to seamlessly connect businesses with tailored, efficient, and innovative service solutions. Through cutting-edge technology, unparalleled expertise, and a commitment to excellence, we aim to optimize supply chains, streamline operations, and enhance customer service and satisfaction. Together, we navigate challenges, deliver reliability, and create lasting partnerships that drive growth and success for our clients in an ever-evolving marketplace.
about:
Vermont Manufacturing Services (VMS) operates from West Rutland, Vermont, where it has provided contract manufacturing, fulfillment, and packaging services for more than 30 years. The company was acquired in 2011 by Jessica Dambrackas, who purchased the business from its previous incarnation as Rutland Industries.

The company runs a 12,000-square-foot facility with climate-controlled warehousing and loading docks. Its services span kitting, packaging, and assembly (including hand assembly), pick-and-pack order fulfillment, e-commerce integration, warehousing, cross-docking, quality control, distribution, and inventory management.

VMS serves electronic manufacturers, food packaging companies, e-commerce retailers, fashion labels, and publishing houses such as the Rutland Herald.

Dambrackas established a mission to employ as many individuals with disabilities as possible, and the company operates on lean manufacturing principles. VMS also emphasizes fixed pricing to simplify forecasting and offers e-commerce software that connects to shopping carts within minutes.

name: Valley Woodcraft & Lumber Co
old_description: relationships. Our commitment to our promise is unparalleled.
about:
Valley Woodcraft & Lumber Co., based in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, was founded in 1952. The company operates as a small, veteran-owned contract manufacturer serving a range of industrial sectors.

The shop produces custom wood, phenolic, composite, and machined plastics components, delivering everything from single parts to fully assembled products built to print specifications. Its process capabilities include CAD/CAM design, CNC machining with nested-based production, drilling, finishing, profiling, sanding, shaping, mortise-and-tenon joinery, laminating, gluing, fingerjointing, paraffin treatment of lumber, and both commercial and Mil-Spec packaging. The facility offers standard, express, and urgent delivery options to meet varying lead-time requirements.

Valley Woodcraft serves customers in aerospace, aviation, defense, furniture, maritime, rail, transit, transportation, construction, and utilities. The company’s quality system is certified to ISO 9001 and AS 9100 for the manufacture of high-precision machined parts used in defense, aviation, aerospace, transportation, and other industries.

The firm emphasizes assured product quality, competitive pricing, on-time delivery, and the flexibility to fulfill orders of any size. Its veteran-owned status and dedicated team with advanced technology are cited as key differentiators that enable rapid response to urgent customer needs.

name: Valley Woodworkers
old_description: The Valley Woodworkers of West Virginia cares about our community and does what we can to improve it.  The mission of the Valley Woodworkers of West Virginia is twofold.  One part is the training of local community members to be woodworker. Whether it be honing their craft to later become a professional woodworker, or merely to create handcrafted heirloom pieces for their friends and family.  Secondly, since 1991, the Valley Woodworkers have been making heirloom quality wooden toys for the Salvation Army to distribute to underprivileged children at Christmas.
about:
Valley Woodworkers operates from Dunbar, West Virginia. The organization was founded in 2008 and functions as a woodworking club open to all skill levels. Its origins trace to a dual mission: training local residents in woodworking crafts and producing heirloom-quality wooden toys for the Salvation Army’s Christmas distribution to underprivileged children, a program ongoing since 1991.

The club holds monthly meetings on the second Thursday at its clubhouse on 12th Street, featuring project show-and-tell sessions and technical demonstrations. Beyond member education, volunteers manufacture wooden toys year-round for charitable donation. The facility serves as a gathering point rather than a commercial production shop; no headcount, square footage, or output volumes are published.

Participants range from beginners to professional woodworkers, while the toy program benefits children served by the Salvation Army. Local businesses such as Woodcraft and Withrow Supply in Huntington provide sponsorship and material support, including finishes, machinery, hardware, and sharpening services.

The group emphasizes community improvement through skill-sharing and charitable giving. Its distinguishing feature is the long-standing commitment to producing handcrafted toys for children in need, coupled with an open-door policy that welcomes anyone with an interest in woodworking.

name: Valley Woodworks LLC
old_description: Most furniture is manufactured to be replaced. Engineered composites, spray-on finishes, metal fasteners hidden beneath a surface that mimics wood without being it. It looks fine on day one. By year three, it shows you exactly what it was.
about:
Valley Woodworks LLC is a custom furniture maker based in Palmer, Massachusetts. Founded in 2022 by Jonathan Dias, a Springfield College graduate with a background in business administration and entrepreneurial studies, the company began from his desire to create high-quality, handcrafted pieces that avoid the disposable nature of mass-produced furniture.

The shop produces custom tables and furniture using solid hardwood slabs selected for grain, moisture content, and character. No veneers, plywood cores, or shortcuts are used; each piece is finished with hand-rubbed hardwax oils that protect the wood while keeping its pores open and grain visible. Operations are carried out on a made-to-order basis, with no stated facility size or employee count beyond the founder.

Valley Woodworks serves residential clients seeking heirloom-quality dining tables, desks, and other furniture pieces. The company does not list specific commercial or industry clients, focusing instead on individual commissions that start with a design consultation.

Dias started the business to counter the click-to-buy culture and preserve the art of fine furniture making. The company emphasizes that its pieces are built to be passed down rather than replaced, a philosophy reflected in the choice of solid materials and traditional finishing methods.

name: Vault Furniture
old_description: As an American-made furniture company, we pride ourselves on providing a high quality product with great customer service. We offer a wide variety of furniture options, and we are always happy to work with customers to create the perfect custom solution for their space.
about:
Vault Furniture operates from Caldwell, Idaho, where it was co-founded by designer Brandi. The company began as a maker of reclaimed-wood furniture and has grown into a high-end manufacturer of handcrafted shelving, desks, tables, and home accessories.

The shop produces made-to-order pieces using reclaimed old-growth pine, sustainably sourced ash and black walnut, American steel, and low-VOC finishes that carry GREENGUARD certification. Processes include custom design consultation, woodworking, metal fabrication, and finishing. All items are built in the Caldwell facility; home accessories and brackets typically ship in one to two weeks, while furniture and shelving units require three to four weeks.

Vault Furniture serves residential and commercial customers seeking custom furniture and shelving solutions. Its product line spans wall-mounted shelving units, desks with integrated power, coffee and console tables, benches, bar carts, vases, wine racks, and pet feeders. The company works directly with clients—including interior designers and homeowners—to develop tailored pieces for specific spaces.

The business was founded on a pledge to create heirloom-quality furniture from sustainably sourced materials while providing exceptional customer service. Differentiators include free custom design support with co-founder Brandi, free shipping and exchanges within the contiguous United States, and a commitment to 100 percent U.S. handcrafting.

old_description: Founded in 1973, Vehicle Parts/HQ 911 is the premier emergency equipment installer in the New Orleans area.  Vehicle Parts designs, sells and installs Police, Fire and EMS equipment.  We specialize in lighting and installations for all types of emergency vehicles.  Vehicle Parts stocks more than 25 brands of vehicle products from lights and push bumpers to car batteries.
about:
Vehicle Parts, operating as HQ 911, was founded in 1973 in Jefferson, Louisiana, as a family-run business serving the New Orleans metropolitan area. The company began as an installer of emergency vehicle equipment for local public safety agencies.

The shop designs, sells, and installs lighting, push bumpers, and other upfitting components for police, fire, and EMS vehicles. It carries more than 25 brands of parts, ranging from light bars to batteries, and provides repair services for existing installations. The facility on Deckbar Avenue in New Orleans handles both new vehicle builds and retrofit work.

Customers include municipal police departments, fire districts, and emergency medical service providers throughout the region. The company outfits patrol cars, fire apparatus, and ambulances with warning lights, sirens, consoles, and power management systems.

The owners emphasize a family-business approach, offering personalized service and competitive pricing rather than volume-driven sales.

name: Velmar Food Services
old_description: Velmar Food Services is an Arizona-based, family-owned Company. Home to the Arizona Gold brand, the Company has been perfecting the art of flavorful food since it was founded in 1974. Select spices, locally-produced tortillas, robust beans, cheese, green chiles and love for nutrition all go into making Arizona Gold the highest quality brand.
about:
Velmar Food Services operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where Richard and Judith Barton founded the family-owned company in 1974. The business traces its recipes to Richard's father, who applied his culinary craftsmanship to develop the perfect burrito. Now a third-generation family-run enterprise, Velmar has grown from supplying mobile food services to serving unified school districts across Arizona and California.

The company manufactures its Arizona Gold brand of Mexican cuisine — including burritos, appetizers, entrees, side dishes, and desserts — using locally produced tortillas, robust beans, cheese, green chiles, fresh eggs, and choice meats. In addition to production, Velmar runs a foodservice distribution operation that stocks breakfast, lunch, center-of-the-plate entrees, and desserts from top labels. Its warehouse and freezer facilities also provide pallet storage leasing for other food businesses needing seasonal or overflow capacity.

Velmar's customers include restaurants, delis, convenience stores, healthcare facilities, correctional operations, and school districts throughout Arizona and California. The Arizona Gold line has become a staple in school meal programs, while the distribution side supplies a broad range of foodservice operators through local distributors.

Velmar emphasizes cultural authenticity and flavor maximization while minimizing cost, a philosophy rooted in the founding family's recipes. The company differentiates itself by combining manufacturing, distribution, and warehousing under one roof, allowing customers to simplify procurement from a single source. Community involvement, including sponsorship of local charities, is also cited as a core value.

name: Velocity Metalworks
old_description: Our precision machining capabilities use the latest CNC and Electronic Discharge (EDM) techniques, to handle complex and intricate shapes on components large or small.
about:
Velocity Metalworks was founded in 1970 and operates from two Illinois locations: its headquarters in Hoffman and a second facility in Belleville. The company has remained independently owned for over five decades, though the ownership structure is not publicly specified.

The shop delivers full-service metal manufacturing, encompassing tool and die building, precision metal stamping, fabrication, CNC machining, EDM, assembly, and finishing services such as powder coating and polishing. It positions itself as a total supply-chain partner, handling engineering, design, prototyping, production, and fulfillment under one roof. Facility sizes and headcount are not disclosed.

Velocity serves tier‑1 suppliers and OEMs across demanding industries, though specific sectors are not named on its website. Its customer base consists of manufacturers that require tight‑tolerance metal components and complete assemblies.

The company’s stated mission is to manufacture metal solutions so customers who value “Made in America” can compete and win. It differentiates itself through a multi‑layered quality system — continuous in‑process inspections, a double‑check setup verification, and a culture of shared quality ownership — backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification.

about:
Vergent Products operates from Loveland, Colorado, where it was founded in 1996. The company was established on two core principles: exceptional client experience and the engagement of a diverse team of experts focused on continually elevating client success.

The firm provides end-to-end electronics design and manufacturing, spanning product design (electrical, mechanical, firmware/software), printed circuit board assembly on multiple SMT lines with robotic selective solder and hand solder, 100% automated optical inspection, X-ray inspection, functional and in-circuit testing, final product assembly, system integration, configure-to-order, warranty and repair services, and supply chain management including 3PL distribution, advanced component stocking, and risk mitigation. Its quality system integrates ERP, PDM, and MES in a fully digital factory with full traceability and a proprietary preventive system. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Vergent serves original equipment manufacturers in medical devices, measurement and controls, aerospace and defense, industrial and critical environments, energy generation and alternative energy, and automotive electrical systems.

The company emphasizes unsurpassed on-time delivery, a 100% digital factory with integrated ERP/PDM/MES, full traceability, and a proprietary preventive system as key differentiators. It was started to deliver a complete and comprehensive product delivery experience, promising kept commitments, mutual trust, and uncommon dedication to the client’s mission.
